convert_perception_lm_weights_to_hf: convert PerceptionLM weights from Meta format to HuggingFace Transformers format using input and output directories
build_perception_lm_model: build a HuggingFace PerceptionLM model by converting Meta checkpoint weights to HF format with tokenizer
create_perception_lm_tokenizer: create a PerceptionLM tokenizer by converting a SentencePiece model to HuggingFace PreTrainedTokenizerFast format
write_perception_lm_tokenizer: write a PerceptionLM processor with image, video processors and chat template to disk or HuggingFace Hub
run_conversion_cli: run the PerceptionLM weight conversion CLI with input_dir, output_dir, and optional push_to_hub flag
